🎥🍿: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The legendary Vermont State Troopers are back, and this time they’re bringing even more chaos, confusion, and outrageous comedy. When a routine investigation takes an unexpected turn, the team finds themselves caught up in a bizarre case filled with unpredictable criminals, ridiculous situations, and their own completely unconventional approach to police work.

Featuring the return of the original cast, Super Troopers 3 delivers the same hilarious energy fans love with more pranks, quotable moments, and the unforgettable chemistry that made the franchise a comedy favorite. Get ready for another wild adventure full of nonstop laughs and classic trooper madness.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
